name: Israeli Air Force
tagline: Born mid-war in 1948 from a handful of smuggled and surplus aircraft, and forged by decades of conflict into one of the world's most combat-experienced air arms.
bio: The Israeli Air Force was established on 28 May 1948, days after Israel declared independence and while the country was already at war. Its first fighters were Avia S-199s - Czechoslovak-built derivatives of the German Bf 109 - smuggled in and flown by a mix of Israeli pilots and overseas volunteers, soon joined by ex-Czechoslovak Spitfires. From those improvised beginnings it grew into a force defined by audacious operations, most famously Operation Focus in June 1967, the pre-emptive strike that destroyed the bulk of three Arab air forces on the ground in the opening hours of the Six-Day War.

Israeli squadrons have flown the Mirage III, F-4 Phantom, F-15 and F-16 through repeated wars and countless smaller actions, racking up more jet-versus-jet victories than almost any other air arm and shaping how several of those types were developed and upgraded. Today the force fields large F-16 and F-15 fleets, AH-64 Apache attack helicopters and the F-35I "Adir", a uniquely Israeli-modified variant of the Lightning II - making it the first air force outside the United States to use the F-35 in combat.
